newsitem.title: UGANDA: Uganda opens workshop for stock exchange players.
newsitem.headline: Uganda opens workshop for stock exchange players.

text.p: Uganda's Finance Minister Jehoash Mayanja Nkangi on Thursday launched a workshop for prospective brokers, dealers and investment advisers for the yet to be opened Kampala Stock Exchange.
The workshop, organised by the Capital Markets Authority, will focus on rules and regulations to govern the bourse whose opening date has not yet been announced.

Uganda has already cleared some companies tp open brokerage subsidiaries. These include Stanbic Bank, Barclays Bank, The Merchant Bank of East Africa, NDC Capital Alliance and Trans Africa Bank, officials said.
When the bourse opens and trading begins, it will be by an open outcry system on the lines of the Nairobi Stock Exchange.

But it was still uncertain when trading would begin. The East African Development Bank building in Kampala, which was due to house the bourse, is still under renovation. Authorities have no idea when the construction work will be completed.
